evidence.explanation: This exact caller passes literal AD_FIRE or AD_ELEC. Both lie in the callee accepted AD_MAGM..AD_ACID range. The sole note_unported marker is in the complementary else arm, and adtyp is never reassigned. No global spell or terrain equivalence claim.
evidence.proof: source-proof.mjs checks both C/JS call sites, complete callee guard and marker, and C damage constants against JS values; AD_PHYS is an out-of-range discriminator control. Pinned native Grand Master fire-pillar and lightning recordings reach both spells and compare all streams. General castmu and polymon keys remain active.
